\label{sec:conclusions} The studies of sections~\ref{sec:method}--\ref{sec:stability} and of the companion note give five checks to make before the intervals of an unbinned unfolding are interpreted, each with what it found here.
Closure should include the backgrounds (section~\ref{sec:closure}).

Truth changes of generator size should be recovered, and what is not recovered measured, as the retained fraction of the prior; here part of the prior is retained, and binned iterative unfolding moves past the truth at the two flagged truths (sections~\ref{sec:closure} and~\ref{sec:prr}).

Coverage should be tested at changed truths, jointly as well as per cell, and the joint statistic read in the covariance's eigenbasis; here the two-dimensional test flags \fvval{cov2d-nunder-ar23} and \fvval{cov2d-nunder-g18} of the 205 cells while its joint test fails at both tunes, its $\chi^2$ dominated by mean bias in the poorly determined directions (section~\ref{sec:calib}).

Robustness should be tested against rounding-level input changes as well as training seeds; here the result is bitwise independent of the seed but not stable under rounding, which on the pseudo-experiment studied acts through ties among equal float32 inputs (section~\ref{sec:cov5d}).
Run periods should be compared before and after unfolding; here a step between period groups is present before unfolding and survives it (section~\ref{sec:closure2d}).
